title: Battery Breakthrough Improves Grid Storage Efficiency
summary: Researchers report longer cycle life in early trials.

body.text: Early reactions from the community have been broadly positive, though some raised questions about timing.
The announcement follows months of speculation and comes as competition in the sector intensifies.
